facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions are transfer of resources or obligations between related parties, regardless of whether a price is charged. Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly or indirectly, to control the other party or exercise significant influence over the other party in making financial or operating decisions. Parties are considered to be related if they are subject to common control or common significant influence.
